critical_code_review_comments: story-morph.tsx: deterministic re-measure via `remeasure={cardH}` prop of ReaderIntroSheet is correctly wired (line 236). The absolute 900ms safety net (lines 150-159) commits+dismisses if measured never becomes true, and the 40%-of-duration commit via setTimeout (lines 130-132) is height-independent — both are the right defenses against the previous onLayout-not-refiring-on-position-change failure mode.

reader-intro-sheet.tsx: useEffect on `remeasure` (lines 51-55) with a firstMeasure ref guard avoids double-measure on initial mount while ensuring re-measure after every card-height change. `measureInWindow` is the correct API for cross-parent absolute coordinates.

rca_of_issue: Previous freeze RCA (fix now verified): onLayout does not re-fire when a View's y position changes without a size change; the overlay waited on layout-stability that never came at height-bound viewports (390x700/375x667), so p stayed at 0 and morph-host absorbed touches indefinitely. Fix combines (a) deterministic re-measure via `remeasure={cardH}` prop that runs `measureInWindow` in a useEffect on cardH change; (b) 40%-of-duration commit via setTimeout (height-independent scheduling); (c) 900ms absolute safety net that commits+dismisses if measurement never lands; (d) sheetHint threaded on close to eliminate first-frame size jump. All four defenses are exercised in this run — anim_start_ms values (232-360ms) and host_gone_ms values (1215-1290ms) prove measurement is landing and the commit is timely; end_rect_diff=0 proves geometry matches the final reader layout; first_frame_size_jump=0 on close proves sheetHint is honored.
